title: ConnectionsParams
description: Generation parameters. Everything optional except seed; defaults produce a full modern city. Toggling a kind off removes that layer entirely (an ancient city can run with only underground tunnels, or nothing).

links.description: selection limits per link kind. Bridges, AC tubes and tunnels pair facing buildings; wires cross a street from facade to facade, so their limits describe that crossing.

dayStart.description: seconds from midnight, first departures; default 18000 (05:00)

dayEnd.description: seconds from midnight, last departures; default 90000 (01:00 next day)

minLength.description: meters; for wires, the facade-to-facade span across the street

maxLength.description: meters; a street wider than this carries no wires

minBase.description: lowest vertical base (meters, +Y) a link of this kind may attach at

maxBase.description: highest vertical base; wires only, where minBase and maxBase are the anchor band (default 4 to 8)

density.description: fraction of candidates that get a link: facing pairs for bridges, tubes and tunnels, anchor stations along a street for wires; 0 disables like the toggle
